source_note: Fig Ops2: simulated PacBio HiFi reads (chr22 PacBio recipe: pbsim3 3.0.5 multi-pass QSHMM-RSII, 10 passes, then ccs 6.4.0 defaults; template lengths from the real PacBio workload, about 60 Mbases of whole ACGT-only reads) from the forward records of the 8 held-out mtb152 genomes; read set and its manifest in inputs/fig_ops2/sim-mtb152-pacbio-60mb-v1
rule: uppercase; split every record at each run of characters other than A, C, G and T, which are dropped; empty pieces dropped; records renamed q0, q1, ... in source order (map.tsv gives each source record and 0-based half-open range)
